narr: A large complex of thunderstorms stagnated over parts of southern Illinois, along and north of Interstate 64. Thunderstorms trained across those areas within an environment highly capable of producing high rainfall rates. Precipitable water values ranged between 2 and 2.5 inches, along with modest instability (500 to 1500 J/kg of elevated cape). The axis of thunderstorms occurred northeast of a surface boundary over southwestern Missouri, along an elevated convergence axis. The steering flow was nearly parallel to the convergence axis, supporting training and repeating of storm cells. A remnant mesoscale convective vorticity center over western Illinois advanced southeast in the northwest mid-level flow. This feature helped initiate thunderstorms through the night.
